text: Sequential assessment 2026-09-12: retain P1; current source still supports the reported scope distinction. FitConfig.scala derives RunSpecific for RunwiseLeastSquares, while the GLS interpreter prepares run/censor partitions and produces DenseFmriFitResult through one fitted design. Existing AR censor scenario qualifies noise segmentation; it does not establish independent run coefficient/readout semantics. FixedEffects already combines via full inverse coefficient covariance, so do not replace it with diagonal or sample-count weights. Remaining work should first demonstrate an ordinary supported composition (possibly explicit run-specific design structure) with truthful coefficient-axis/scope metadata, full voxelwise covariance and bounded selected execution; only add a new strategy if current composition cannot satisfy those contracts. The distinction is qualification and scientific identity, not missing GLS arithmetic. Retain unequal runs, planted different effects, censor gaps, known-covariance oracle and both-platform acceptance. Source inspected only; no new runtime qualification in this assessment.
